Overview

About Artificial Grass

Artificial grass keeps gardens, balconies and play areas green all year without watering or mowing. A natural look and UV-stable fibres keep it fresh in strong sun.

Beautiful, durable, low-maintenance artificial grass for homes, gardens and commercial spaces. Stays green all year with no watering or mowing.

07

Material guide

Know your material

What it is

Artificial grass is made of synthetic fibres, usually polyethylene or polypropylene, tufted into a backing.

How it is made

Fibres are tufted into the backing and coated to lock them in. UV stabilisers are added for outdoor use.

Installation tip

Lay on a compacted base with a weed membrane, then fix the edges and brush the fibres upright.

Strengths

  • Green all year with no watering
  • UV-stable for outdoor use
  • Ideal for small gardens and balconies

Good to know

  • Can get warm in strong sun
  • Needs a proper base for a flat finish
08

FAQ

Common questions

Does it drain water?

Good backings have drainage holes, and a proper base lets water pass through.

Is it suitable for kids and pets?

It is commonly used in gardens and play areas. Pick a suitable pile height and ask us for product details.
